checks.title: Reserved address has a resource user
checks.description: Checks a current Compute reserved address for a provider reported attachment. A RESERVED address with no users is a cleanup review candidate; this does not establish traffic inactivity.
checks.data_source: Compute addresses aggregatedList full item: selfLink, status, users, native project and GET receipt.
checks.predicate: PASS when status IN_USE and users is nonempty; FAIL when status RESERVED and users is empty; UNKNOWN on RESERVING, disagreement, partial representation, bad identity or source.
checks.remediation_hint: Review the reservation owner and release an address with no intended consumer.

checks.title: Firewall policy has an association
checks.description: Checks whether a project network firewall policy has a current policy association in its full native representation.
checks.data_source: Compute aggregated firewallPolicies full item: selfLink, associations[].attachmentTarget, native project and GET receipt.
checks.predicate: PASS when associations contains a valid target; FAIL when the complete policy has no associations; UNKNOWN on partial representation, bad identity or source.
checks.remediation_hint: Review policy ownership and attach it to its intended target or remove an obsolete policy.

checks.title: Network endpoint group contains endpoints
checks.description: Checks provider reported endpoint count on applicable Compute network endpoint groups. Zero endpoints is current structural absence; this does not establish load balancer traffic inactivity.
checks.data_source: Compute networkEndpointGroups aggregatedList or global list full item: selfLink, networkEndpointType, size, native project and GET receipt.
checks.predicate: PASS when size is positive; FAIL when size is zero; NOT_APPLICABLE to SERVERLESS and PRIVATE_SERVICE_CONNECT; UNKNOWN on missing count, partial representation, bad identity or source.
checks.remediation_hint: Review the endpoint group owner and populate intended endpoints or remove an obsolete group.
